'''August 2001 Raleigh tournament (Game Night)''' was a Star Wars CCG casual held at Games Galore in August 2001. It is known from Philip Marschall's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2919">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-03-game-night-games-galore-8-28ish-01d2919/ game-night-games-galore-8-28ish-01], DeckTech (Philip "WorldChamp" Marschall, 3 September 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-03-game-night-games-galore-8-28ish-01d2919/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' August 2001
* '''Site:''' Games Galore
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
